title: declareCommands deduplicates identical sets
description: Verifies that the same set of commands in any order is not re-sent to avoid unnecessary messages.
given: A client that has declared a set of commands
when: The same set is declared again (in same or different order)
then: No additional postMessage call is made; a different set does trigger a new message
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::does not re-send an unchanged set, whatever order it arrives in
